sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the convenience nltl:sideStructureApplicability boolean gate and its mandatory-presence check with the canonical structural-member relationship/path and controlled value that establishes side-structure membership (including nltl:sideStructureLocation). That required relationship/path is not supplied in the scoped vocabulary, so locate it before repair; then apply the load-case demand and plastic-strength comparison only to those selected side-structure longitudinal local frames.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add the COMPLETE-contract relationship and controlled-value obligations for frameProfileType and sideStructureLocation using their canonical owner/path; do not place frameProfileType directly on the ship because its supplied domain is benchmarkEntity. The scoped vocabulary supplies no valid ship-to-that-owner path or usable sideStructureLocation predicate/value pattern, so request the canonical path/term mapping before freezing.

Remove the unsupported frameProfileType constraint and its flatBarSection/profileSection alternatives: it is not an I2-034 obligation and is checked on structuralMember although its authoritative requiredOwner is ship. Complete the declared side-structure controlled-value applicability model instead of adding unrelated profile requirements; the needed canonical relationship/path for sideStructureLocation is absent from the scoped vocabulary, so request it via the matcher and use it to select applicable structural members.

Replace the convenience nltl:sideStructureApplicability boolean gate and its mandatory-presence check with the canonical structural-member relationship/path and controlled value that establishes side-structure membership (including nltl:sideStructureLocation). That required relationship/path is not supplied in the scoped vocabulary, so locate it before repair; then apply the load-case demand and plastic-strength comparison only to those selected side-structure longitudinal local frames.

Use this exact term because it is the supplied canonical ObjectProperty for the frame-profile relationship, with range frameProfileTypeValue; resolve its owner/path through the required structural-member model rather than placing it directly on ship.

Remove the unsupported frameProfileType constraint and its flatBarSection/profileSection alternatives: it is not an I2-034 obligation and is checked on structuralMember although its authoritative requiredOwner is ship. Use this exact term because I2-034 explicitly applies to longitudinal local frames in side structures, and sideStructureLocation is the supplied canonical controlled-value term for representing that side-structure applicability; do not use frameProfileType, profileSection, or flatBarSection.
